title: chore(deps): move @objectstack/* to the next prerelease ^18.0.0-next.0 and follow its contract (objectui#12030)
body:
Fixes #12030
Clause-②: yes — 22 published `@object-ui/*` packages declare a consumer-facing `@objectstack/*` range that moves from `^17.x` to `^18.0.0-next.0` (21 in `dependencies`, 1 in `peerDependencies`, counted from the manifests at the head), so a release would carry a published-contract change. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` at `2c15e40cf`: "102 source file(s) and 1 published-contract change(s) of 18 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)". `.changeset/12030-objectstack-next-18.md` declares the 22 packages `minor`, with the breaking-for-consumers note in its body.

follow-up: objectstack-ai/objectui#12334

**Scope: the `@objectstack/*` move to `^18.0.0-next.0` and the fixes it forces. No objectui release.** Releasing objectui 18.x (the AGENTS.md §版本号策略 sync `major`, Changesets pre mode on `next`, and the two gate edits ruled in records 6148150305 and 6149296149) moves to the follow-up card above, per the scope split recorded as 6149376719. This branch carried the sync `major` and `.changeset/pre.json` for a while (`0b942ba`); they are reverted (`7ec3c2b`), and neither gate script is edited.

**Known effect after merge, intended:** `Spec Range Floors` (`scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`) cannot read `^18.0.0-next.0`: at the head it exits 1 with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field". Its nightly alarm on `main` turns red, and `pnpm changeset:publish` cancels any publish until the follow-up lands. That is the fail-safe that stops a 17.x release declaring 18 ranges. The open version PR #11600 (`changeset-release/main`) refreshes toward 17.8.0 and must not be merged before the follow-up.

## What this does

- Every `@objectstack/*` range in `dependencies`, `devDependencies` and `peerDependencies` moves to `^18.0.0-next.0`: 40 ranges in 32 manifests (26 / 13 / 1). Raised textually; `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated by `pnpm install` only, never hand-edited. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 and a second plain `pnpm install` leaves the lockfile byte-identical (measured at `e8e9a35`; lockfile and manifests unchanged since).
- npm dist-tags read today for the four `@objectstack/*` packages objectui names (`spec`, `client`, `formula`, `lint`): `next: 18.0.0-next.0`, `latest: 17.7.0`; every `18.0.0-next.0` tag peels to objectstack `d889448b93`. `next` had not moved when the final head was pushed, so objectstack-ai/objectstack#23160 (`1912af47ba`, compare reads `behind`: not an ancestor) is not in this release and #12325's reader removal stays out of scope.
- Every break the bump caused that is a mechanical follow-through of a v18 contract change is fixed here. Where a break needed a behaviour or design choice, the PR keeps today's behaviour and says so in the test; the seat judged or routed each one (record 6148150305).

## The break list (measured first, at `a3f41ed`: the bump and changeset alone)

Full vitest suite in five lock-held groups: 50 files, 159 tests red (types/core 15 files / 58 tests, app-shell 21 / 45, plugins A 6 / 20, plugins B 1 / 4, console + scripts 7 / 32). `turbo run build` and every package's `type-check` were green at that commit (81/81). Two repo gates were red: `check:eager-closure` (exit 2, ceilings drifted to 1.74x / 1.21x) and `check:installed-pin-claims` (23 findings). By area, and how each is closed:

- **Overlay scope is `env` only** (objectstack#15206 S5; card comment 6098299437): data-objectstack overlay fixtures and docblock, two app-shell fixtures, and the zh scope label table drops its `org` row (an `org` from an older server renders raw), as the ruling's seat judgment says.
- **Index `unique: true` refused at protocol 18** (objectstack#22103): the index-fallback probe pins the refusal with a `false` control, the validation-preview help (en, zh) names `unique: 'organization'` / `unique: 'global'`, and the `data-protocol.ts` docblock says refused. These are the three sites #11864 names; its legacy-row rendering case still passes and is left as is.
- **Capabilities**: `manage_mailboxes` in, `manage_org_presentation` out; curated label set, default label, ten locale packs.
- **Page blocks**: the element:number / element:repeater / element:record_picker flat query keys and object-grid `defaultFilters` are tombstones refusing by name (objectstack#11509). The number and repeater arms take the spec row by reference; the record_picker node and registration stop publishing the four keys; the parity, arm, harvest and ratchet pins read the tombstones.
- **Retired reads removed** (seat judgment under the ruling): `ObjectGrid` no longer reads `defaultFilters` and `ObjectView` no longer reads `table.defaultFilters`; no in-repo producer writes the key. The tests that pinned it as a working alias are flipped to pin it inert beside a canonical `filter` control; the plugin-view README and docs page, the registration's `filter` description and the type's JSDoc say retired. The element:repeater renderer's flat `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` fallback reads stay: `apps/console/src/dev/DevLists.tsx` writes `properties.object` and `properties.limit` and is routed in `App.tsx`, a live in-repo producer, reported instead of deleted. element:number and element:record_picker already read the binding only.
- **New spec checks and keys**: `checkPageSlotPair` attached to both page node schemas beside the existing page checks (and listed among the chained refinements in the import-boundary census); `checkPagePrintComposition` and `checkListViewChartBinding` read a discriminator and are listed as not attachable; ObjectSchema's 45th key `attachedOnRead`; record:details sections' experimental `count` listed as deferred; the three new record component types stay out of the block palette, as today.
- **ListView `requiredPermissions`**: pinned as the one pending declaration; the seat files a declare-and-enforce card.
- **Flow dialect** (ADR-0032 §3): flow fixtures move to the spellings v18 accepts. The value-role ledger now names six key/value maps; each node's own config schema was measured to refuse a malformed envelope with exactly the sentences the editor shows. A `{token}` string in a value slot is refused by the spec and the editor shows that refusal; the recipient picker's `{…}` spellings and a blank Notify title are pinned as PENDING. The Studio cutover rides #11824.
- **Approver `position`** is a registry binding in v18: the spec-17 loosening is removed and the identity, directory and lookup pins read the registry arm.
- **Submit-redirect / url action**: the refusal pins read the spec's own message; a url action target fixture is a path.
- **Installed-spec claims**: re-measured and restamped where the fact holds, one historical mention ledgered; `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` moves to `18.0.0-next.0`; `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` re-synced by its script; lockfile-integrity samples re-keyed; the declared-floor reader in core's test reads a prerelease floor by its core triple.

## #11762: the eager-closure line comes down by the payback

objectstack#22044 (`93125aeeb8`) is an ancestor of the `18.0.0-next.0` tag commit (compare `ahead`, behind 0; control: the 17.7.0 tag commit `4e4e881427` also reads `ahead`). Two console builds, one container, one instrument (`CI=true pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2` under the verify lock, reading `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`):

| chunk | `cea429b` (main, 17.7.0) | `5488ae7` (this branch) | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `vendor-objectstack` | 1,599,281 | 1,512,690 | -86,591 |
| `ui-components` | 285,771 | 284,925 | -846 |
| everything else (70 names) | 1,324,632 | 1,324,848 | +216 |
| aggregate | 3,209,684 | 3,122,463 | -87,221 |

`MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3,281,467 to 3,194,246 and `BASELINE` onto `5488ae7`; `vendor-objectstack` ceiling 1,623,000 to 1,536,409 and its baseline onto the same build. Lowered by the amount, not re-derived and not rounded; `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` untouched. Headroom 71,783 bytes = 0.79x on the aggregate, 23,719 = 0.26x on `vendor-objectstack`: what `main` had on `cea429b`. The ruling's two later edits reach bundler inputs; the console build of `5db13ba` reads 3,122,375 (-88), inside the band, recorded in the `BASELINE` prose and not re-pinned. The upstream figure (-226,301 on the chunk) was on an injected dist; the real release nets -86,591 here.

## Held cards: their Restart-when probes at the head

| card | probe | at the head (`18.0.0-next.0`) | control |
|---|---|---|---|
| #11773 | `MetadataConflictErrorSchema` in the spec's `.d.ts` | exit 0 (next tarball and installed tree) | `@latest` (17.7.0) tarball: exit 1 |
| #11545 | `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates` is a function | exit 0 | 17.7.0: exit 1 |
| #11681 | a release carrying the objectstack#21995 change (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22021, `c5658133fc`) | met: ancestor of `d889448b93` | |
| #11970 | lockfile resolves `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/objectql` carrying `4578c56e65` | half: core `18.0.0-next.0` carries it; objectql is in no objectui manifest or lockfile, so the probe cannot be met as written | |
| #11958 | spec/ui exports `PagePrintSchema` and `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` | exit 0 | 17.7.0: exit 1 |
| #11864 | spec carries `ef1fcb26a2` | met; its three sites are changed in this PR | |
| #11762 | spec tag commit has `93125aeeb8` as ancestor | met; executed in this PR | |
| #12270 | `EmptyStateSchema` link + `InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState` | exit 0 | 17.7.0: exit 1 |
| #12271 | `ListDraftsResponseSchema` reads a draft's `member` | exit 1 as written: the probe's fixture has no `label`, which the schema requires (`drafts.0.label` invalid_union). With `label` added: exit 0 | with `label`, 17.7.0: exit 1 |
| #12192 | `SECTION_HEADING_COUNT_HOLE` is a RegExp | exit 0 | 17.7.0: exit 1 |
| #12314 | `stampCommentBodyEdit` in `@objectstack/plugin-audit` dist | the probe reads `@latest` (17.7.0): exit 1. Run against `@next` (18.0.0-next.0): exit 0 | |

## Gates (final head `2c15e40cf`; each reading names the commit it ran on)

- **Install:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exit 0, then a plain `pnpm install` leaves `pnpm-lock.yaml` byte-identical (sha256 compared), at `e8e9a35`; the lockfile and every manifest are unchanged since (`git diff e8e9a35 HEAD` over them is empty). Lockfile diff against `cea429b`: +106 / -106.
- **Build:** `CI=true pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --concurrency=2`, exit 0, 35/35 tasks, at `5db13ba` (the last commit touching a bundler input); the whole published set was built (43 tasks) by `pnpm check:published-dist` at `e8e9a35`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --continue`, 81/81, at `5db13ba` (later commits touch only scripts, tests and the changeset); `pnpm type-check:scripts && pnpm type-check:vitest-setup && pnpm type-check:e2e && pnpm type-check:vitest-config`, exit 0, at `2c15e40cf`.
- **Tests** (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, five lock-held groups):
  - types, core, react, i18n, cli, data-objectstack and 12 more at `5488ae7`: 1019 of 1020 files; the red one (`imported-defaults-8317`, from attaching `checkPageSlotPair`) is fixed in `ef2054e` and re-ran green (267 tests). Later commits touch these packages only in one JSDoc.
  - app-shell at `ef2054e`: 1319 passed, 1 skipped (12,730 tests). After the `org` label drop, the four overlay-scope files re-ran green at `2e80824ea` (21 tests).
  - plugin-detail, plugin-grid, plugin-form, plugin-dashboard, components at `2e80824ea`: 1207 passed, 2 skipped (12,292 tests).
  - fields and the other 15 plugins at `7ec3c2b`: 1031 passed, 2 skipped (11,505 tests).
  - apps/console, scripts, eslint-rules, examples at `7ec3c2b`: 429 passed, 2 failed. `check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` pinned the rendered `BASELINE` literal: re-taken in `2c15e40cf` and green there. `date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` is red at `2c15e40cf` too, and is NOT caused by this diff: its forked child fails one case, the suite-zone control of `FormulaFunctions.dateOnlyZone-10866`, which reads `Asia/Shanghai` (11:00) instead of UTC (03:00). That is the zone another pin file sets last. The `unit` project runs `isolate: false`, and the file order comes from each worktree's vitest cache. Run alone in the same forked child at `2c15e40cf`, that file passes (39/39). The same driver passed 28/28 at `a3f41ed` in a fresh worktree. This diff touches neither the pin files nor the code they exercise.
- **Repo gates at `2c15e40cf`**, exit 0 unless noted: `check-changeset-presence` (above), `check-changeset-no-major` ("No changeset declares a `major` bump."), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:installed-pin-claims` (`OK`), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:eager-closure` ("3049.2 KB gzipped across 72 of 2255 chunks (budget: 3119.4 KB, headroom: 70.2 KB)", every ceiling in range). `check:spec-floors` exits 1, the known effect above. `.changeset/pre.json` is absent. `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:unused-deps` and `check:published-dist` were green at `2e80824ea` / `e8e9a35` and nothing they read has changed since.

## Acceptance notes

- Records: the v18 ruling 6148150305 and the gate ruling 6149296149 both move to the follow-up card. This change is the dependency move only, per the split record 6149376719. The seat's judgments under 6148150305 are executed here: drop the zh `org` label, remove the retired reads. Its follow-up cards carry ListView `requiredPermissions` (declared and enforced together), the three record component types, holding a blank Notify title, and the file field's `metadataRefused` marker; #11824 carries the Studio flow-dialect cutover.
- Kept at today's behaviour and pinned as pending, for those cards: the recipient picker's `{…}` spellings; a blank Notify title, which is sent and shows the server's refusal; a `{token}` value-slot text cell, which commits as typed and shows the spec's refusal; the new record component types, which stay out of the palette; ListView `requiredPermissions`, still undeclared.
- The element:repeater renderer keeps its flat-key fallback reads: `apps/console/src/dev/DevLists.tsx` (routed in `App.tsx`) writes `properties.object` / `properties.limit`, a live in-repo producer.
- `isValueEnvelopeSlot` serves `KEY.*` ledger paths only, as before. The ledger's whole-value `value` slots (the record nodes' `filter`, loop/map `collection`, notify `recipients`) are not key/value maps, and this change leaves them alone.
- #11864's legacy-row case (`EmbeddedItemEditor.indexFallback`, a stored bare `unique: true` still renders) passes and is left as is: an 18 server serves such a row as `'global'`.
- Two held cards' probes cannot exit 0 as written. #11970 names `@objectstack/objectql`, which no objectui manifest or lockfile carries. #12271's fixture lacks the required `label`.
- AGENTS.md §版本号策略 names `OBJECTUI_ALLOW_MAJOR=1` as the sync-major switch, and nothing in `.github/` sets it. That is the follow-up card's to settle; this change leaves AGENTS.md alone.
